name: dsh-plugin-plan
title_zh: 先定插件骨架再动手，避免返工
tagline_zh: 写代码前先定清插件形态、角色、依赖、配置与证据归属。适合设计 DSH Cordis 插件但不想立刻实现时。
tagline_en: Before writing code, lock down plugin shape, roles, deps, config, and evidence ownership. Turns vague asks into.
desc_en: Use as the planning stage of dsh-plugin-development, or when asked to design a standalone DSH Cordis plugin without implementing it. Decide plugin form, roles, dependencies, configuration, invariant ownership, profile composition, evidence, and distribution before files are copied or code is written.
why_zh: 它把规划从实现中硬拆出来，强制你在复制文件前回答所有权与组合问题——比边写边想多一层结构约束。
why_en: It hard-separates planning from implementation, forcing ownership and composition decisions before any file lands—structural.
limit_zh: 只覆盖规划阶段，不写任何代码或生成文件。若你已开始实现、或目标不是 DSH Cordis 插件，它不会产出可运行结果。
limit_en: Planning only—no code or file output. Useless mid-implementation or for non-DSH Cordis targets; it stops at blueprint level.
